flags.field: burst[1].everyN / burst[2].everyN / skill2[1].everyN (= the Super Firepower cadence)
flags.estimate: everyN:3, everyNOffset:1 — Super Firepower on her 1st, 4th, 7th burst; Firepower Charge on the other two.
flags.reasoning: Stack/currency steady-state DERIVED from kit-stated start + consume + rebuild (priors rule 10). Start 100 (skill2). Burst 1: gauge=100 → Super, −100 → 0. Burst 2: 0<100 → Firepower Charge 10s, gaining +1 (cast) +2 per full charge +45 (charge end). Charges in a 10s window: chargeFrames 60 = 1.0s/shot, ammo 6, reloadFrames 141 = 2.35s → 6 shots in 6.0s + 2.35s reload + 1 more ≈ 7 charges → +14. Total ≈ 1+14+45 = 60 < 100 → burst 3 also takes the charge branch (60+60 = 120, capped 100) → burst 4 is Super. Period 3, phase 1. NOTE: the redacted types.ts comment independently asserts the same everyN:3/offset:1 shape for this unit (see leakDetected).
flags.recipe: Record one full fight and log her burst casts. Confirm the Super branch (the 45.03% Attack Damage buff + the extra Full-Charge damage popup) appears on bursts 1 and 4 and NOT on 2 and 3. If the real charge count per 10s differs (see flags[1]), recompute: if a charge rotation rebuilds >=100 the cadence collapses to everyN:2/offset:1; if <50, it stretches to everyN:4.

flags.field: (derivation input) base cadence tuple — chargeFrames 60 / reloadFrames 141 / ammo 6
flags.estimate: ~7 full charges per 10s Firepower Charge window (≈1.0s per charge shot, one 2.35s reload inside the window).
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #1: charge/reload frame fields are datamine-unreliable, and this one is load-bearing twice over — it sets the gauge rebuild (flags[0]) AND the proc count of the 437.98%/262.79% riders, which is essentially her whole damage output.
flags.recipe: Frame-count one magazine in a recording: charge-start → shot-landing frames, and reload-start → first-shot-restored. Feed the measured shots/10s back into the flags[0] arithmetic BEFORE trusting the cadence.

flags.estimate: 75 (= 5% x an assumed gauge charge of ~15 at Full Burst end), for 5s, on the two charge rotations.
flags.reasoning: The kit value is a LIVE product: 5% x the Firepower Gauge charge amount at the moment Full Burst ends. The sim does not track the pool, so a static number must stand in. Her Firepower Charge starts at her burst cast and runs 10s; Full Burst also runs ~10s from a slightly later start, so at FB end the gauge should still be mid-charge (+1 cast, +2 x ~7 charges ≈ 15) and NOT yet hold the +45 charge-end bonus. If the +45 lands first the correct value is ~300, a 4x difference — this is the single widest ⚑ in the file.
flags.recipe: Read the in-game Firepower Gauge number on the frame Full Burst ends, on a charge rotation; multiply by 5. Cross-check the effect indirectly by timing the NEXT burst: a 75%-for-5s burst-gen buff should shave a measurable amount off the following rotation vs a run with the block removed.

flags.estimate: Super Firepower modeled as a 10s name-keyed BOSS status opened by her Super burst, gating the 262.79% rider.
flags.reasoning: Faithful behaviour, deliberately non-faithful channel: the engine offers no timed SELF-status gate, and the alternatives are worse — fbGate:'inFb' alone fires the rider on all three rotations (≈3x over-credit) and dropping the line loses a real 262.79%-of-ATK damage source. Statuses are name-keyed so no other kit can open or be opened by it. HYPOTHESIS, not a fact: I have not verified the validator accepts this usage or that the window opens on the cast frame rather than at FB entry.
flags.recipe: Run validate-overrides; if the channel is rejected, re-home the rider (do NOT drop it). Then confirm the window edges: in footage, check whether the boosted Full-Charge popup appears on charges fired in the ~1s between her burst cast and Full Burst opening (status keyed to cast) or only inside the FB window.

flags.estimate: One proc per full charge shot (chargeCounter count:1) rather than per trigger pull (shotFired).
flags.reasoning: The text says 'when landing a Full Charge attack', so the literal read is the per-full-charge counter. shotFired would be equivalent only if every RL trigger pull in the sim resolves as a full charge; if partial-charge shots exist, shotFired over-credits.
flags.recipe: Count the 437.98% popups against the shot count in one magazine of a recording — 6 shots must yield exactly 6 riders. Also confirm the sim emits a charge event per RL shot (an event-log assertion on a chargeCounter block is enough; no new footage needed).

flags.field: skill1[0].effects[0] / skill1[1].effects[0] — crit, core, flavor, noFb
flags.estimate: crit:true, no core, no flavor tag, noFb unset (rider takes Full Burst by timing).
flags.reasoning: Per the priors: function-damage riders crit at the caster's rate, get NO core unless the text says 'core strike damage' (it does not), and default to FB-eligible. 'Firepower Explosion' is suggestive of the projectileExplosion flavor on an RL kit, but the text never names Projectile Explosion Damage, so tagging it would invent bucket eligibility.
flags.recipe: Read popup colours on the rider hits in a recording (orange + icon = crit; a red 'CORE HIT' would refute the no-core call). Compare rider magnitude inside vs outside Full Burst to confirm the +50% major applies. If a Projectile Explosion Damage ▲ source is ever run alongside her, a magnitude change on the rider would settle the flavor question.
